Affiliate Benefits

Join today and start earning with ETHA! 🚀

Welcome to the ETHA Affiliate Program! By signing up and participating in the program, you agree to abide by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

1. Eligibility

  • You must be at least 18 years old to participate in the ETHA Affiliate Program.
  • You must provide accurate and complete information during the application process. ETHA reserves the right to accept or reject any application at its sole discretion.

2. Affiliate Responsibilities

  • Affiliates are responsible for promoting ETHA’s products in an ethical and professional manner, aligning with the brand’s values and mission.
  • Affiliates may only use approved marketing materials provided by ETHA or content that has been reviewed and approved by ETHA.
  • Affiliates must not engage in any deceptive, misleading, or unethical marketing practices, including but not limited to false advertising or making unsupported claims about ETHA’s products.

3. Affiliate Commissions

  • Affiliates earn commissions on completed purchases made through their unique affiliate links.
  • Commissions are calculated as a percentage of the sale amount, excluding taxes, shipping, discounts, or refunds.
  • ETHA reserves the right to adjust commission rates and payment schedules. Affiliates will be notified of any changes in advance.

4. Payment Terms

  • Commissions are paid out monthly, provided the affiliate has reached the minimum payout threshold of $50.
  • Payments are made via the method selected during the application process. Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information and for any fees associated with payment processing.

5. Prohibited Activities

  • Affiliates may not promote ETHA’s products on websites or platforms that contain inappropriate, offensive, or illegal content.
  • Affiliates may not bid on ETHA’s trademarks or brand terms in paid search campaigns, including but not limited to “ETHA,” “ETHA Natural Botanicals,” or similar terms.
  • Affiliates are prohibited from engaging in spamming or any other forms of unsolicited communication.
  • Affiliates may not misrepresent themselves as employees or representatives of ETHA.

6. Intellectual Property

  • ETHA grants affiliates a non-exclusive, revocable right to use its logos, trademarks, and marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting ETHA’s products.
  • Affiliates may not modify or create derivative works of ETHA’s intellectual property.
  • All rights, titles, and interests in ETHA’s intellectual property remain the exclusive property of ETHA.

7. Termination

  • Either party may terminate the affiliate agreement at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice.
  • Upon termination, affiliates must cease all use of ETHA’s intellectual property and remove any promotional materials from their channels.
  • ETHA reserves the right to withhold unpaid commissions if the affiliate is found to have violated these terms and conditions.

8. Disclaimer

  • ETHA makes no guarantees regarding the success or earnings potential of affiliates. Affiliates are solely responsible for their performance and results.
  • ETHA reserves the right to modify or discontinue the affiliate program at any time, with or without notice.

9. Limitation of Liability

  • ETHA will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the affiliate program.
  • Affiliates agree to indemnify and hold ETHA harmless from any claims, damages, or liabilities resulting from their participation in the program.

10. Governing Law

  • These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to its conflict of law principles.

By joining the ETHA Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these terms and conditions. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@ethanaturals.com.

Thank you for partnering with ETHA!
